messages:
anya: quick heads-up — PR #2145 has a couple of nits after CI: naming in kvcache.go, and a format nit in server/test_file.go. can someone take a quick pass? planning to merge in the 2pm PT merge window.
ravi: I can do a quick sweep in ~15m. which branch is this on?
anya: branch is feat/kvcache-optim. main CI failures are:
- golangci-lint: var shadowing / naming
- gofmt formatting in tests
snippet:
```
- ctxTimeout := 50
+ timeoutMs := 50 // renamed for consistency
```
mike: I think timeoutMs is better than ctxTimeoutMs. fewer chars, still clear.
anya: linter flagged `ctxTimeout` as shadowed in handler.go (gosimple). also a test file had trailing spaces.
ravi: can we align with other variables like readTimeout -> use timeoutMs? less churn in callers.
mike: will push a tiny commit to rename + run `gofmt`. pinging @sasha @jen for a second reviewer :pray:
ci-bot: build started for commit 7a3c2f7
ci-bot: golangci-lint reported: simplify: redundant assignment at cache/loader.go:42
mike: fixing the redundant assign now.
sasha: can take a look after mike's commit; if CI is green i'll approve.
jen: small request — please add a one-line comment mentioning units (ms) so it's obvious.
ravi: pushed commit 7a3c2f8 — renamed to `timeoutMs`, added comment, ran `gofmt -w .` and fixed the redundant assign.
ci-bot: build passed on commit 7a3c2f8; all checks green ✅
mike: reviewing... looks good to me, approving now.
mike: approve :white_check_mark: 
anya: thanks team. merging in ~2m during merge window. :shipit:
